name: deepseek-research-agent
description: A portable Codex plugin that installs a DeepSeek-only research agent skill.

interface.longDescription: Install a Codex skill that runs a local DeepSeek-only Python research agent, generates evidence cards, and saves a Markdown report. It does not call Tavily or live web search.
defaultPrompt: Use $deepseek-research-agent to research: AI Agent 在企业知识库场景是否值得落地？
